answer: A backdoor works by implanting malicious software into a system during the supply chain distribution process. This allows an attacker to cause disruption or enable further compromises once the system is deployed. The malicious software is designed to provide the attacker with unauthorized access to the system, which can lead to various follow-up attacks [Source 2].
